name: Perform a rehearsed piece
short_description: Deliver a memorised five-minute artistic piece while maintaining timing, structure, and recovery after one disruption.
self_assessment: I can perform a five-minute rehearsed piece without help and recover from one disruption.
description: Deliver a memorised five-minute artistic piece while maintaining timing, structure, and recovery after one disruption. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Perform a memorised dramatic or musical piece
